prompt: Round 2 of 4. The company side proposes (As a first-time collaborator [C032 past_collaborations] we need full IP ownership to integrate results into EdgeWatch a

content.text:
I need to change at most two fields. The main issues are:
1. IP: contract_research_company_owns is problematic - university prefers to own results. I'll push for uni_owns_option_to_licence.
2. Exclusivity: 24 months is too long; I'll propose 12 months.

I'll trade on exclusivity (accept 12 months) to get better IP terms.
